goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: Approve one documentation-only Worker package. The architecture extends proven Phase 3 boundaries without implementation: offline digest-locked font materialization, proof-gated inert-transition normalization, explicit deferred pseudo-element accounting, noncanonical cue candidates, authoritative cues with locked materialized tracks and undoable detachment, revision-external annotations, and an exact paired benchmark.

items: Only offline owner-provided digest-locked font materialization is authorized; all production and proof runs have zero network fetches and other resource kinds remain fail-closed.
Scene C transitions remain fail-closed unless a source-bound certificate plus installed-Chrome equality proof demonstrates an inert declaration; this is not transition support.
Scene E counts only through an untouched-source failure ledger plus a deterministic non-pseudo acceptance projection ledger; pseudo-element motion remains Phase 5.

Cue candidates are ephemeral import-report sidecars with low/medium/high evidence confidence and can never enter the document, persistence, export identity, compiler input, revisions, or automatic operations.
Service, revision, claim, and history contract
Proof, privacy, exclusions, and failure modes

slices: Five-scene import closure and explicit deferrals
Revision-linked review and handoff vertical slice
Paired performance and aggregate Phase 4 gate

items: Cue metadata and materialized tracks diverge, direct edits bypass ownership, or detach/undo changes compiled output or creates dual authority.
External preprocessing, transition normalization, candidate inference, Scene E projection, annotations, or receipts silently drop unsupported behavior or leak private material.
The paired benchmark uses hidden automation, inconsistent timing, noisy single runs, or speed claims whose outputs fail unaffected-track, visual, determinism, Chrome, or undo-restoration safety.

worker_package.objective: Write one exact Phase 4 coach-mark breadth architecture decision at docs/architecture/phase4-coach-mark-breadth.md. Include every required section and clause from T002, the sanitized Scene A-E inventory, all four resolved ambiguities, authoritative cue/generated-track/detach/history operations, reusable cue semantics, compiler/preview and Phase 3 persistence invariants, revision-external annotations/comparison/handoff, the exact three-task paired benchmark and formulas, the five ordered vertical implementation slices, privacy and proof gates, rejected alternatives, owner-facing claim, top three failure modes, and explicit Phase 5 exclusions. Make no product, dependency, fixture, board, or private-corpus change.
verify: test "$(rg -c '^## (Decision and scope|Five-scene grounded inventory|Import and candidate boundary|Canonical cue and generated-track contract|Cue semantics|Compiler and preview invariance|Service, revision, claim, and history contract|Annotations, comparison, and handoff|Paired benchmark contract|Ordered implementation slices|Proof, privacy, exclusions, and failure modes)$' docs/architecture/phase4-coach-mark-breadth.md)" -eq 11
stop_if: Any required decision cannot be written exactly from T001, the owner decisions, merged Phase 3 evidence, and this receipt without inspecting or copying private source content.
Writing requires a product file, package.json, package-lock.json, dependency, migration, fixture, screenshot, private corpus artifact, evidence payload, or file outside allowed_files.

The architecture would allow live resource fetching, generalized resource loading, invented Scene B motion, unproven Scene C transition dropping, silent Scene E pseudo-element omission, or Phase 5 pseudo-element implementation.
The architecture would persist cue candidates, accept candidate IDs as mutations, infer semantic cues without explicit confirmation, or include candidates in canonical/export identity.

The architecture would introduce cue-time compilation, runtime cue interpolation, direct edits to attached generated tracks, bidirectional cue/track synchronization, nondeterministic IDs, or non-atomic detach/history.
The architecture would let annotations or comparison affect canonical/export identity or add approval, assignment, merge, publishing, notification, or project-management workflow.

The benchmark cannot state all three exact paired tasks, three alternating repetitions, median calculations, combined Motion <= 50% CSS, no task slower, ordinary-user tooling, and every safety/undo gate.
Private source, copy, branding, selectors, filenames, paths, URLs, screenshots, payloads, or source-digest prefixes would enter the architecture.
A verification command fails twice for the same unresolved architecture or privacy cause.

parallel_safety.reason: All decisions must remain internally consistent in one architecture document.
